extracted.intended_audience: research administrators, NSF staff, grant managers, and researchers seeking NSF award records
extracted.subtask_description: A complete catalog of National Science Foundation program grants and contracts awarded in Fiscal Year 1981, organized by NSF program and by geography, listing award-level metadata (PIs, titles, numbers, durations, amounts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Report scope — included funding sources
rubrics_metrics.description: This report includes all grants and contracts funded from the National Science Foundation’s Salaries and Expenses Appropriation and Special Foreign Currency Appropriation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report explicitly states these are the funding sources whose FY1981 obligations are listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report exclusions — types of transactions omitted
rubrics_metrics.description: This report excludes: (1) Transactions funded from Program Development and Management Funds (such as procurements for routine housekeeping activities); (2) Awards (or portions of awards) using funds transferred to NSF by other Federal agencies; (3) Administrative transactions such as extensions of project duration or amendments to modify grant or contract terms which do not involve the obligation of FY 1981 funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These exclusion categories define which NSF-related financial actions are not reported as FY1981 awards in this listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization of listing by program and geography
rubrics_metrics.description: The listing is organized by specific NSF programs within areas (mathematical and physical sciences; engineering; biological, behavioral, and social sciences; astronomical, atmospheric, earth, and ocean sciences; scientific, technological, and international affairs; ocean drilling, U.S. Antarctic, and other programs; science and engineering education and fellowships; special foreign currency; fellowships and traineeship awards). Awards are arranged by state or country and, within each state or country, by institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should look up awards first by NSF program area, then by state/country and institution. The table of contents enumerates the program-area divisions used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award entry data fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Information provided for each award includes principal investigator(s), project title, award number, project duration, and amount awarded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every award listing in the report will contain these core metadata elements; this defines the minimum descriptive fields included for each record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-program funding notation
rubrics_metrics.description: An asterisk following the award number indicates that the project is funded by more than one NSF program or appropriation and may appear more than once in the report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The asterisk is a notation rule to flag awards that are cross-listed; users should expect duplicate appearances for such projects in different program sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship table interpretation
rubrics_metrics.description: The table entitled 'Fellowship Awards' reflects the number of awards accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counts in the fellowship tables are based on accepted awards (not necessarily offers), and users should interpret those totals accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arrangement and presentation conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards are presented by program area and then by state/institution; entries use a consistent format (PI name; project title; award number; project duration; dollar amount).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report uses consistent line-entry formatting across institutions and programs (examples throughout the document illustrate the exact layout and ordering of fields).
